summary: Implementation plan for the new Music page (/musikk) and individual Song pages (/musikk/:slug), featuring a searchable and filterable song grid, persistent bottom audio player, full-screen song lyrics composer in the admin panel, multi-format audio upload (MP3, M4A/AAC, Opus, WAV) with Firebase Storage and automatic Firestore chunk fallback, bilingual support (Norwegian/English), optional audio download, and reader comments.
